newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 25.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The People's Bank of China, the central bank, has issued an urgent circular re-affirming a ban on government departments being guarantors for foreign firms.
- Experts from the central bank say economic data in the first five months of this year indicates the state is having a tough task controlling the flow of cash into the economy.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai's third bridge across the Huangpu river, the Xupu Brigde, opened to public traffic on Tuesday.
- Chen Yuan, deputy governor of the central bank, says China will maintain different currencies on the mainland and in Hong Kong after the Chinese takeover of the British colony.
- China now has a total of 4,400 wholesale markets for grains and oils, agricultural side products and daily commodities.
